topic: Visualizing Divergence and Curl in Vector Fields

sections.title: Intuitive Hook: The Flowing River
lecture_lines: Vector fields assign direction to every point.
Wind and water are natural examples.
Points influence flow through expansion or rotation.
animations: Create a smooth blue stream flow across the screen #2196F3.
Display particles moving along the stream lines.
Highlight particles accelerating in a narrow channel.

sections.title: Divergence: The Source or Sink
lecture_lines: Divergence measures net flux out of volume.
animations: Draw a circle representing an expanding fluid region.
Animate outward arrows showing divergence at a source.
Animate inward arrows showing convergence at a sink.

sections.title: Curl: The Micro-Rotation
lecture_lines: Curl measures rotation at a point.
animations: Draw a paddle wheel spinning in the fluid.
Show counter-clockwise rotation indicating positive curl.
Show clockwise rotation indicating negative curl.

sections.title: Mathematical Bridge: The Del Operator
animations: Display the del operator symbol '∇' in yellow #FFEB3B.
Show '∇' dot product with vector field for divergence.
Show '∇' cross product with vector field for curl.

sections.title: Synthesis and Summary
lecture_lines: These define complex global flow behavior.
